title: SourceIndexService
responsibility: Indexes revision-bound source, imports, declarations, storage syntax and execution facts, resolving component props and caching parsed blobs with bounded reads.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.constructor.tree
inputs.description: Snapshot whose read() supplies the component and imported source text the resolver inspects; the constructor only stores it, and nothing is imported or executed from it.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.constructor.files
inputs.description: Indexed file map that the resolver consults for each file's language and resolved reference paths when following imports; the constructor only stores it and does not modify it.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path of the component or TypeScript file whose $props() declaration is resolved; the file is read through the snapshot, and a rejected read rejects the call.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs.owner
inputs.description: Component name written before each resolved prop as Owner.prop; resolveComponentProps passes the component's export name, and the value is not validated.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs.seen
inputs.description: Visited type-reference keys that stop recursive prop-type resolution; once more than 32 keys are recorded, nothing further is resolved. When omitted it defaults to new Set<string>(), a new empty Set on each call.

inputs.name: resolveComponentProps.tree
inputs.description: Snapshot whose read() supplies the Svelte component source and the imported prop-type source; list() is not called.

inputs.name: resolveComponentProps.files
inputs.description: Indexed file map keyed by repository-relative path; each Svelte file whose component export resolves props has that export's inputs replaced in place, and other entries are left unchanged.

inputs.name: SourceIndexService.index.tree
inputs.description: Snapshot whose list() supplies the entries and whose read() supplies the text of each readable, non-ignored entry, and index() keeps at most 256 of those reads in flight. A rejected list or read rejects index(), and the snapshot's revision becomes the index revision.

inputs.name: SourceIndexService.index.config
inputs.description: Configuration passed to classifyPath, which assigns each kept file its classification, workspace and identity and omits files classified as ignored. Its references entries override import resolution for the same from and specifier, resolving to the entry's to path or otherwise marking the reference external.

references.reason: Generated catalog file that is tracked in this repository.
Published package resolved outside this repository.

inputs.name: importedBinding.file
inputs.description: Parsed TypeScript source whose top-level import and export-from declarations are searched in statement order; the first match wins and the file is not modified.

inputs.name: importedBinding.name
inputs.description: Local name of a default or named import, or exported name of a re-export with a from clause, to resolve to its original name and module specifier; namespace imports and local exports without a from clause never match.

inputs.name: selectedProps.items
inputs.description: Prop fields with bare names, as member resolution produces them; the array and its items are not modified, because the transforms return new arrays and Partial and Required return copied items.

inputs.name: selectedProps.operator
inputs.description: Partial makes every item optional and Required makes every item required; Pick keeps the items whose names appear in keys, and any other operator, such as Omit, keeps the items whose names do not appear.

inputs.name: selectedProps.keys
inputs.description: Key type node that Pick and Omit read for string literal names, alone or in a union; when it is absent or has no string literal names, Pick and Omit return an empty array, and Partial and Required ignore it.

inputs.name: scanStorage.code
inputs.description: TypeScript module text whose exported classes with a static definition property are read; it is parsed but never evaluated, so no import, validator or table access runs.

inputs.name: sourceExecution.code
inputs.description: Source text inspected only when language is 'ts', where it is parsed without being executed; any top-level statement other than an interface, type alias, ambient declaration, type-only import or export, or empty statement makes it runtime unless the code has parse diagnostics, which make it unknown.

inputs.name: sourceExecution.language
inputs.description: Indexed language that selects the classifier: 'css' is declarative without reading the code, 'ts' is parsed, and 'svelte' or 'other' are unknown.

inputs.name: sourceExecution.path
inputs.description: Path passed to the TypeScript parser as its file name when language is 'ts', which the parser uses to choose how to read the text, such as JSX for .tsx; the file is not read from disk.

outputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs
outputs.description: Resolves to the prop fields named Owner.prop, with source-written types, required flags and literal defaults from the $props destructuring (including $bindable arguments); an optional prop with no destructuring initializer gets 'undefined (omitted)'. It resolves to an empty array when the file declares no $props() call.

outputs.name: resolveComponentProps
outputs.description: Resolves with no value once each Svelte component export that resolves props has its inputs replaced in place; other files are left unchanged.

outputs.name: SourceIndexService.index
outputs.description: Resolves to the snapshot's revision and a files Map keyed by repository-relative path, with ignored entries omitted; cached parses that this index does not use are released before it resolves.

outputs.name: importedBinding
outputs.description: The original binding name and module specifier, where a default import reports 'default'; undefined when no supported import or re-export binds the name.

outputs.name: selectedProps
outputs.description: The transformed items: Partial and Required return copies with required set, Pick and Omit return the filtered original items, and unresolved keys give an empty array.

outputs.name: scanStorage
outputs.description: One storage record per exported class with a static definition, giving its table, primaryKey (defaulting to 'id'), and fields with type, required, nullable and literal default values, with unresolved syntax listed as text. It never creates tables or reads rows.

outputs.name: sourceExecution
outputs.description: 'declarative' for CSS and for TypeScript whose top-level statements are all types, ambient declarations or type-only imports and exports; 'runtime' for other parsed TypeScript; and 'unknown' for Svelte, other languages and TypeScript with parse diagnostics, and unknown is never assumed declarative.

errors.name: Source read or parse failure
errors.description: Rejections from the snapshot's list() or read() calls, and exceptions from parsing or prop resolution, reject the call; no partial index is returned.

errors.name: Source syntax access failure
errors.description: Values outside the documented types, such as an undefined file, throw whatever property access or the TypeScript parser raises; these transforms perform no I/O and catch nothing.
